certifiedResults.countyCrosswalk: 2024 Hawaii numbered precinct names map House districts 01-08 to Hawaii County, 09-14 to Maui County except precinct 13-09, 15-17 to Kauai County, and 18-51 to Honolulu County. Official precinct 13-09 (split IDs 78 and 487) is pinned to Kalawao County FIPS 15005.

reviewCharts.warning: Hawaii review rows are same-grain President-versus-U.S.-Senate precinct/split rows from the official Office of Elections media.txt export. The parser excludes three zero-vote non-geographic President keys (PRES, OS I, OS II) from advisory rows; numbered precinct/split review rows aggregate to the certified statewide presidential total. County labels use the documented district-range crosswalk with exact precinct 13-09 pinned to Kalawao County FIPS 15005; they are reproducible reporting assignments, not loaded precinct-boundary geometry. Advisory rows are public-interest source-review signals only, not findings of fraud or misconduct.

turnout.notes: Hawaii turnout rows use the official Hawaii Office of Elections 2024 General Election registration and turnout statistics table. The four election-county rows (Hawaii, Maui, Kauai, and Honolulu) reconcile exactly to the statewide table: 522,236 turnout and 860,868 registered voters. The table has no separate Kalawao turnout/registration row, so none is allocated; Kalawao result votes are independently derived from precinct 13-09.

historicalBaselines.warning: Hawaii historical baseline rows are official 2012, 2016, and 2020 Office of Elections President results aggregated with reviewed year-specific pre-reapportionment district ranges: 01-07 Hawaii, 08-13 Maui, 14-16 Kauai, and 17-51 Honolulu. Precinct 13-09 split ID 78 is separated from Maui and pinned to Kalawao FIPS 15005. The 2012 export includes 476 overseas non-geographic President votes, which remain unassigned to county rows. Every county tuple, statewide total, and 2012 non-geographic exclusion is asserted.
